 Far From Ordinary...

 
 
 

 
 
 
	

 
 

 
 Homedhonsvick2026-03-02T17:35:31+00:00 
 Welcome to Cosmo’s Restaurant & Bar
Off the beaten path on Canal Road in Orange Beach, Cosmo’s Restaurant & Bar is far from ordinary. Serving fresh and eclectic food since day one, Cosmo’s features a wide range of dining, enticing even the most discriminate. Using chef inspired ingredients, you can enjoy everything from hand-cut steaks to local seafood and pasta.
This neighborhood favorite on the Gulf Coast has taken cuisine to the cutting edge. With variations of local staples, their versions will make you sit back and take notice. Culinary greats such as the chicken roulade, the sesame seared tuna salad and the traditional crab cakes done with a twist, will have you wanting more. And to top it all off, The Year of Alabama Food named their Banana Leaf Wrapped Fish as one of “the top 100 dishes to eat before you die.” This epicurean delight is just one of the many masterpieces created daily in this out-of-the-way hot spot on Alabama’s Gulf Coast.
Experience Distinctive Dining

What can we serve you?
Our extensive menus offer a variety of options and have something for everyone. Why not start with our Crab Cakes or Tuna Poke Nachos? Next, try one of our specialties like Seafood Pasta, Asian Glazed Tuna or our Pork Chop. Don’t forget to try one of our mouthwatering desserts such as our Key Lime Pie or Banana Fritters. We can’t wait for you to join us!

Happy Hour
We have the best on the Island! Our Happy Hour is served daily from 3 to 5 p.m. It features specials on draft beer, house wines, delicious appetizers, and $2 off all sushi rolls. Our Firecracker Shrimp is known as a local favorite and made us famous! So what are you waiting for?
